title: 2D Versus 3D Diffusion for In Silico Training of Interventional X-ray AI Models
summary: The ability to synthesize realistic X-ray images has catalyzed the development of AI models for X-ray image-guided procedures, which otherwise suffer from a lack of available annotated data. Prior work has demonstrated the effectiveness of mechanistic simulation of digitally reconstructed radiographs (DRRs) as a training data source for a myriad of tasks, including segmentation and anatomical landmark detection, with comparable or superior performance to real data training. However, mechanistic DRR synthesis still relies on the availability of annotated high-resolution anatomical models. Deriving these from CT images of real patients or specimens imposes an undesirable bottleneck on data quantity and variability. In this work, we explore two methods for synthesizing training data: (1) a 3D conditional latent diffusion model that generates CT volumes to use as inputs for mechanistic DRR generation without real, 3D anatomical models, and (2) a view-conditioned 2D diffusion model that produces synthetic X-rays. In controlled experiments, we demonstrate that synthetic 2D diffusion-based X-rays can be used to train an anatomical landmark detection model that generalized to real X-ray images with performance rivaling that of a model trained on real X-ray images. Thus, we provide preliminary evidence that synthetic, 2D diffusion-based training data can substitute for real X-ray data, identifying a promising avenue towards generating large, diverse datasets for training robust AI models in interventional X-ray imaging.
tldr: This paper compares 2D vs 3D diffusion models for generating synthetic X-ray training data, showing that 2D diffusion-based synthetic X-rays can train anatomical landmark detection models to perform comparably to models trained on real X-ray data, offering a scalable alternative to real data.
tldr_zh: 本文比较了2D和3D扩散模型生成合成X射线训练数据的效果，发现基于2D扩散的合成X射线能够训练出性能与真实数据相当的解剖标志检测模型，为替代真实数据提供了可扩展的方案。
summary_zh: 合成逼真X射线图像的能力推动了用于X射线图像引导手术的AI模型的发展，而这类模型原本受限于缺乏可用的标注数据。已有研究表明，数字化重建放射影像（DRRs）的机械仿真作为训练数据源，在分割、解剖标志点检测等多项任务中表现有效，其性能可与真实数据训练相媲美甚至更优。然而，机械DRR合成仍依赖于标注的高分辨率解剖模型。从真实患者或样本的CT图像中获取这些模型，对数据量和多样性造成了不利的瓶颈。在本研究中，我们探索了两种合成训练数据的方法：（1）一种三维条件潜扩散模型，用于生成CT体积数据，作为机械DRR生成的输入，无需真实的三维解剖模型；（2）一种视图条件化二维扩散模型，用于生成合成X射线图像。在受控实验中，我们证明基于二维扩散的合成X射线图像可用于训练解剖标志点检测模型，该模型能够泛化到真实X射线图像，其性能可与在真实X射线图像上训练的模型相媲美。因此，我们提供了初步证据，表明基于二维扩散的合成训练数据可以替代真实X射线数据，为生成大规模、多样化的数据集以训练鲁棒的介入X射线成像AI模型指明了有前景的方向。

title: Discrete Geometric Modeling and Extended State Estimation of Continuum Robots
summary: In this paper, we present a fully discrete approach for the accurate and numerically efficient dynamical modeling and state estimation of continuum robots. The model is based on geometrically exact beams in a minimal, strain-based formulation and derived in the framework of Lie group variational integrators, allowing to preserve important geometric properties that we exploit to achieve high accuracy and numerical efficiency. We then propose a disturbance observer based on an extended Kalman filter formulation that reliably estimates system states as well as model uncertainties and external disturbances. Experiments on a real system validate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed model and observer.
tldr: Presents a discrete geometric modeling approach for continuum robots using Lie group variational integrators and an EKF-based disturbance observer for state estimation, validated on a real system.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种基于李群变分积分的连续机器人离散几何建模方法，并结合扩展卡尔曼滤波扰动观测器进行状态估计，在真实系统上验证了其准确性和效率。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种全离散方法，用于实现连续体机器人精确且数值高效的动力学建模与状态估计。该模型基于最小应变公式中的几何精确梁，并在李群变分积分器框架下推导，从而能够保留重要的几何特性，我们利用这些特性实现了高精度与高数值效率。随后，我们提出了一种基于扩展卡尔曼滤波公式的干扰观测器，可可靠估计系统状态以及模型不确定性和外部扰动。在实际系统上的实验验证了所提模型与观测器的精度与效率。

title: Learning-Based Modeling of Soft Robots via Cosserat Rod Theory
summary: Modeling soft robot dynamics is challenging due to their continuum structure and typically nonlinear dynamics. Creating models based on first-order principles is typically time-demanding, and their expressiveness is limited, whereas data-driven models lack interpretability and physical consistency. This work aims to overcome these challenges by introducing a port-Hamiltonian Gaussian Process Regression framework for learning and simulating the dynamics of planar, rod-like soft robots. In detail, the proposed model integrates Cosserat rod theory and Hamiltonian physics with data-driven inference to preserve the system's energy structure while accurately learning the rod dynamics. Numerical simulations show that we can achieve accurate and energy-consistent representations of a rod-like soft robot, showing the potential for a robust and interpretable pathway for modeling complex continuum mechanics.
tldr: This paper proposes a port-Hamiltonian Gaussian Process Regression framework that integrates Cosserat rod theory with data-driven inference to model planar, rod-like soft robots, achieving accurate and energy-consistent dynamics.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种结合Cosserat杆理论与数据驱动推理的端口-哈密顿高斯过程回归框架，用于模拟平面杆状软体机器人，实现了准确且能量一致的动力学建模。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
由于软体机器人具有连续体结构和典型的非线性动力学特性，其动力学建模颇具挑战性。基于第一性原理的建模方法通常耗时且表达能力有限，而数据驱动模型则缺乏可解释性和物理一致性。本研究旨在通过引入一种端口哈密顿高斯过程回归框架来克服这些挑战，用于学习和模拟平面杆状软体机器人的动力学行为。具体来说，所提出的模型将Cosserat杆理论与哈密顿物理学相结合，并借助数据驱动推理，在精确学习杆动力学的同时保持系统的能量结构。数值模拟表明，我们能够实现对杆状软体机器人准确且能量一致的表示，展示了为复杂连续介质力学建模提供稳健且可解释途径的潜力。

title: Neurosymbolic Clinical Trial Matching via LLM-Driven Abduction and Logical Verification
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a promising path to automate Clinical Trial Matching (CTM), but still struggle with the deterministic verification required for complex eligibility criteria. Conversely, purely symbolic methods provide formal rigour but break down when faced with incomplete patient records and noisy clinical evidence. To bridge this gap, we investigate a hybrid framework for CTM combining LLMs with logical verification. In particular, we introduce an abductive neurosymbolic CTM framework (αNeSy-CTM), which leverages the linguistic and world knowledge in LLMs to support reasoning over noisy and underspecified clinical text. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that αNeSy-CTM substantially outperforms standalone LLM baselines, achieving up to 30% relative improvement over zero-shot baselines. In addition, our analyses confirm the impact of abductive reasoning on CTM, with αNeSy-CTM exhibiting improved accuracy, specificity, and robustness over a non-abductive neurosymbolic setting. Furthermore, αNeSy-CTM and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning prove highly complementary, highlighting the potential for a hybrid routing policy. Ultimately, this paper demonstrates the impact of neurosymbolic methods for automating CTM, providing a path toward the next generation of auditable, LLM-driven clinical applications.
tldr: This paper presents αNeSy-CTM, a neurosymbolic framework that combines LLMs with logical verification and abductive reasoning for clinical trial matching, achieving up to 30% relative improvement over zero-shot LLM baselines and demonstrating complementary benefits with Chain-of-Thought reasoning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了αNeSy-CTM，一种结合LLM与逻辑验证和溯因推理的神经符号框架，用于临床试验匹配，相比零样本LLM基线实现了高达30%的相对改进，并展示了与Chain-of-Thought推理的互补优势。
summary_zh: 大规模语言模型（LLM）为自动化临床试验匹配（CTM）提供了有前景的路径，但在处理复杂入组标准所需的确定性验证方面仍存在困难。相比之下，纯符号方法具有形式严谨性，但在面对不完整的患者记录和有噪声的临床证据时则会失效。为弥合这一差距，我们研究了一种结合LLM与逻辑验证的混合CTM框架。具体而言，我们提出了一种溯因神经符号CTM框架（αNeSy-CTM），该框架利用LLM中的语言知识和世界知识，支持对带有噪声且信息不明确的临床文本进行推理。大量评估表明，αNeSy-CTM显著优于独立的LLM基线，相比零样本基线实现了最高30%的相对改进。此外，我们的分析证实了溯因推理对CTM的影响，与非溯因神经符号设置相比，αNeSy-CTM展现出更高的准确性、特异性和鲁棒性。同时，αNeSy-CTM与思维链（CoT）推理被证明具有高度互补性，突显了混合路由策略的潜力。最终，本文证明了神经符号方法在自动化CTM中的影响力，为下一代可审计、由LLM驱动的临床应用指明了方向。

title: PROTON: Prototype-Based Test-Time Online OOD Detection for Medical VLMs
summary: Medical vision-language models (VLMs) enable zero-shot clinical image classification, yet reliably detecting out-of-distribution (OOD) inputs at deployment remains an open problem. No static scoring method works across all shift types: Maximum Concept Matching (MCM) on FLAIR achieves 76.4% AUROC for far-OOD but only 42.4% for covariate shifts such as ultra-wide-field fundus images, effectively random. We trace this to a structural mismatch: covariate-shifted inputs are indistinguishable from in-distribution samples in softmax space, yet occupy distinct regions in the VLM embedding space. To exploit this untapped signal, we propose PROTON (PROtotype-based Test-time ONline OOD detection), a lightweight post-hoc module that maintains an online prototype bank from high-confidence test predictions and adaptively fuses prototype distance with MCM scoring via stream-level variance statistics, requiring no model modification, training data, or prompt engineering. On the ophthalmology benchmark FLAIR + FIVES, PROTON improves MCM by +23.9 AUROC on covariate shift, +8.8 on semantic shift, and +8.1 on far-OOD, making it the only zero-shot method to improve all three without hierarchical prompts or labeled data. Code is available at https://github.com/GenMI-Lab/PROTON, and the project page is available at https://genmi-lab.github.io/PROTON.
tldr: PROTON is a lightweight post-hoc module for out-of-distribution (OOD) detection in medical vision-language models (VLMs) that adaptively fuses prototype distances with maximum concept matching, achieving significant AUROC gains across covariate, semantic, and far-OOD shifts without requiring model modification or training data.
tldr_zh: PROTON是一种轻量级事后模块，用于医学视觉语言模型（VLM）的分布外（OOD）检测，通过自适应融合原型距离与最大概念匹配，在协变量、语义和远OOD偏移上均实现了显著的AUROC提升，无需修改模型或训练数据。
summary_zh: 医学视觉语言模型（VLMs）能够实现零样本临床图像分类，但在部署时可靠检测分布外（OOD）输入仍是一个悬而未决的问题。没有任何静态评分方法能适用于所有偏移类型：FLAIR数据集上的最大概念匹配（MCM）对远OOD的AUROC达到76.4%，但对超宽视野眼底图像等协变量偏移仅达到42.2%，实际上相当于随机猜测。我们将其归因于结构失配：协变量偏移的输入在softmax空间中与分布内样本难以区分，但在VLM嵌入空间中却占据不同的区域。为利用这一未被开发的信号，我们提出PROTON（基于原型测试时在线OOD检测），一种轻量级的后处理模块，通过高置信度测试预测维护在线原型库，并利用流级方差统计自适应融合原型距离与MCM评分，无需修改模型、训练数据或提示工程。在眼科基准FLAIR + FIVES上，PROTON将MCM在协变量偏移上提升+23.9 AUROC，在语义偏移上提升+8.8，在远OOD上提升+8.1，使其成为唯一无需分层提示或标注数据即可同时改善这三种偏移的零样本方法。代码可在https://github.com/GenMI-Lab/PROTON获取，项目主页为https://genmi-lab.github.io/PROTON。

title: Translating Inference-Time Control to Radiology Vision-Language Models: Activation Steering for Pneumonia Classification on Chest X-rays
summary: Inference-time engineering can alter model behavior without fine-tuning. However, its utility for improving diagnostic performance in medical vision-language models (VLMs) remains unclear. We aim to evaluate whether Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) can improve pneumonia classification in chest radiograph VLMs without updating model weights. Three frozen chest radiograph VLMs (MedGemma-4B-IT, NV-Reason-CXR-3B, and CheXOne-3B) were evaluated on the public Kermany pneumonia test set. Classification was based on the logits of the tokens Yes and No under a binary prompt. Steering vectors included a 30-pair answer-bias control, a 30-pair pneumonia text contrast, and an image-conditioned contrast derived from 30 pneumonia and 30 normal development images. A deterministic 200-image development set was used for layer and scale selection (100 images) and threshold calibration (100 images). Performance was assessed using ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, F1 score, threshold analyses, reverse-vector controls, random-vector controls, and conditional bootstrap confidence intervals. Fixed-threshold F1 improvements were frequently observed but did not consistently indicate improved diagnostic performance. For MedGemma-4B-IT. NV-Reason-CXR-3B showed the strongest benefit: calibrated F1 improved from 0.7692 in the zero-shot setting to 0.8619 with pneumonia-text steering and to 0.8727 with image-conditioned steering. For CheXOne-3B, pneumonia-text steering increased calibrated F1 from 0.8528 to 0.8666, although the confidence interval crossed zero. On this public pneumonia benchmark, CAA substantially altered prediction score distributions and operating characteristics without fine-tuning. Meaningful performance gains were observed in one of three evaluated VLMs, suggesting that activation steering may serve as a lightweight approach for adapting medical VLM behavior.
authors: Eduardo Moreno Judice de Mattos Farina
tldr: This paper evaluates Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) as an inference-time steering method to improve pneumonia classification in chest X-ray vision-language models without fine-tuning, finding meaningful gains in one of three models.
tldr_zh: 本文评估了对比激活添加（CAA）作为一种推理时间控制方法，在不微调的情况下改善胸部X光视觉语言模型的肺炎分类性能，在三个模型中的一个上取得了显著提升。
summary_zh: 推理时工程可以在不进行微调的情况下改变模型行为。然而，其在提升医学视觉语言模型（VLM）诊断性能方面的效用尚不明确。本研究旨在评估对比激活加法（CAA）能否在不更新模型权重的情况下改善胸部X光片VLM的肺炎分类性能。我们在公开的Kermany肺炎测试集上评估了三种冻结参数的胸部X光片VLM（MedGemma-4B-IT、NV-Reason-CXR-3B和CheXOne-3B）。分类基于二元提示下“Yes”和“No”标记的对数几率。引导向量包括一组30对答案偏置控制、一组30对肺炎文本对比向量，以及由30张肺炎和30张正常发展图像生成的图像条件对比向量。使用一个确定的200张图像的发展集进行层与尺度的选择（100张图像）以及阈值的校准（100张图像）。通过ROC-AUC、PR-AUC、F1分数、阈值分析、逆向向量控制、随机向量控制以及条件自助法置信区间评估性能。固定阈值的F1提升虽频繁出现，但并未一致性地指示诊断性能的改善。对于MedGemma-4B-IT，NV-Reason-CXR-3B显示出最显著的收益：校准后的F1从零样本设置下的0.7692提升至肺炎文本引导下的0.8619，以及图像条件引导下的0.8727。对于CheXOne-3B，肺炎文本引导将校准后的F1从0.8528提升至0.8666，尽管置信区间跨越了零。在该公开肺炎基准上，CAA在不进行微调的情况下显著改变了预测分数分布和操作特性。三个评估的VLM中有一个展现出有意义的性能提升，表明激活引导可作为调整医学VLM行为的轻量级方法。

title: Anatomically Consistent TMJ Disc Segmentation via Semantic Anchoring and Clinical Priors
summary: Segmenting the temporomandibular joint (TMJ) disc from MRI is essential for accurate diagnosis of internal derangement, yet it remains unreliable in practice due to its small size, low contrast, and morphological variability. Existing methods, primarily adapted from general segmentation architectures, often produce fragmented or anatomically inconsistent masks, leading to unstable measurements of disc position and shape for downstream diagnosis. To address these challenges, we propose TISC, a TMJ disc segmentation framework that integrates semantic anchoring with clinical metadata-guided boundary refinement. The framework first establishes robust disc localization in the foundation model feature space via a Prototypical Semantic Anchoring (PSA) module that aggregates adjacent-slice MedDINOv3 features and derives a prototype-driven similarity map. It then performs targeted boundary refinement through a Clinical-Metadata Point Refinement (C-MPR) module, with point-wise predictions modulated by Mouth Open Limitation (MOL), a clinical indicator associated with disc displacement without reduction. On a large-scale cohort of 2,488 PD MRI volumes from 1,300 patients, our method achieves up to a 4.96 Dice improvement over strong baselines across diverse architectures, delivering more anatomically coherent and clinically reliable TMJ disc segmentation.
tldr: A TMJ disc segmentation framework that uses semantic anchoring via prototype similarity maps and clinical metadata-guided boundary refinement to achieve anatomically consistent and clinically reliable results on a large MRI cohort.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种颞下颌关节盘分割框架，通过原型语义锚定和临床元数据引导的边界细化，在大型MRI队列上实现了解剖学一致且临床可靠的颞下颌关节盘分割。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
从MRI中分割颞下颌关节（TMJ）盘对于准确诊断内紊乱至关重要，但由于其体积小、对比度低及形态多变，在实践中仍不可靠。现有方法主要改编自通用分割架构，常产生碎片化或解剖结构不一致的掩膜，导致下游诊断中盘位置和形状的测量不稳定。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了TISC——一个整合了语义锚定与临床元数据引导边界细化的TMJ盘分割框架。该框架首先通过原型语义锚定（PSA）模块在基础模型特征空间中建立稳健的盘定位，该模块聚合相邻切片的MedDINOv3特征并生成原型驱动的相似性图；随后通过临床元数据点细化（C-MPR）模块进行定向边界细化，该模块利用与不可复性盘移位相关的临床指标——张口受限（MOL）来调节逐点预测。在包含1,300名患者的2,488个PD MRI体素的大规模队列中，我们的方法在多种架构上相较于强基线实现了高达4.96的Dice提升，提供了解剖一致性更强且临床可信度更高的TMJ盘分割结果。

title: OpenPINT: Open-source Planning for Isoeffective Nuclear Treatments in BNCT research
summary:
Objective: Present OpenPINT (Open-source Planning for Isoeffective Nuclear Treatments), an open-source treatment planning system for nuclear therapies that integrates Monte Carlo dose calculations with modular dosimetric and radiobiological models for photon-isoeffective dose evaluation.
  Approach: We describe the software architecture, implementation choices, and data flow from segmented geometry and source configuration to NIfTI dose outputs. We define BNCT-relevant dosimetric metrics and evaluate the workflow with reproducible analytic and voxelized cylindrical-phantom benchmarks, supplemented by a geometric patient-positioning example.
  Main results: The module provides a reproducible and scriptable path for generating MCNP-ready inputs, extracting component-wise BNCT dose maps, and computing analysis-ready outputs for quality checks and decision support. Fine-resolution voxelized configurations reproduced the 1 mm analytic reference within 0.13% for the brain-limited irradiation-time endpoint, whereas the full voxelized sweep exposed deviations up to 4.42% in coarse 8--10 mm configurations. Patient-wide gamma pass rates were at least 99.60% for the evaluated mesh/interpolation cases, while low-dose DVH-tail quantities remained sensitive to boundary discretization.
  Significance: This first paper isolates and validates the simulation-preparation and dosimetric-analysis core of an open-source BNCT treatment-planning platform. It establishes a foundation for subsequent work on optimization, biological weighting, and clinical workflow integration.
tldr: OpenPINT is an open-source treatment planning system for Boron Neutron Capture Therapy (BNCT), integrating Monte Carlo dose calculations with radiobiological models for photon-isoeffective dose evaluation, validated with phantom benchmarks.
tldr_zh: OpenPINT 是一个用于硼中子俘获治疗（BNCT）的开源治疗计划系统，它集成了蒙特卡洛剂量计算与放射生物学模型，用于光子等效剂量评估，并通过体模基准进行了验证。
summary_zh:
摘要  
目的：介绍OpenPINT（开源等有效核治疗计划系统），一个用于核治疗的开源治疗计划系统，该系统将蒙特卡洛剂量计算与模块化剂量学及放射生物学模型相结合，用于光子等有效剂量评估。  
方法：本文描述了软件架构、实现选择以及从分段几何和源配置到NIfTI剂量输出的数据流。我们定义了与硼中子俘获治疗相关的剂量学指标，并通过可复现的解析和体素化圆柱形模体基准测试对工作流程进行了评估，同时辅以一个几何患者定位示例。  
主要结果：该模块提供了一条可复现且可脚本化的路径，用于生成MCNP就绪输入、提取分分量BNCT剂量图、以及计算可用于质量检查和决策支持的分析就绪输出。精细分辨率的体素化配置在脑部受限照射时间终点上，与1 mm解析参考值的偏差在0.13%以内；而全体素扫描在粗分辨率8–10 mm配置中显示出高达4.42%的偏差。对于所评估的网格/插值情况，患者整体伽马通过率至少为99.60%，而低剂量区的剂量体积直方图尾部量值仍对边界离散化敏感。  
意义：这是首篇独立验证开源BNCT治疗计划平台中模拟准备与剂量学分析核心的论文。它为后续关于优化、生物学加权及临床工作流程集成的研究奠定了基础。
